summary: Iteration 21: P1-P6 product-quality upgrade verified. Backend (9/9 pass): /api/curriculum/boards/igcse returns 6 subjects (chemistry, physics, biology, mathematics, combined-science, co-ordinated-sciences); each subject has chapters with slugs enabling redirect; combined-science has 14 chapters, co-ordinated-sciences has 14 chapters. Frontend Playwright: All 6 subject URLs /learn/igcse/{subject} correctly redirect (replace:true) to /learn/igcse/{subject}/{first-chapter-slug} — chemistry->atomic-structure, physics->motion, biology->characteristics-of-living-organisms, mathematics->number, combined-science->cell-structure-and-organisation, co-ordinated-sciences->cells. Course workspace on /learn/igcse/chemistry/atomic-structure shows all 5 tabs (Overview, Concept Notes, Workbook, Videos, Downloads). /learn/igcse subject selection page shows all 6 subjects including Combined Science and Co-ordinated Sciences. Homepage: 'Where Curiosity Becomes Mastery' headline present, Explore Learning + Find Past Papers CTAs, animated search bar, 'What are you working on' section, 'Explore Cambridge', Combined Science + Co-ordinated Sciences cards, past-papers finder with 0653/0654 codes, 'Learn. Practise. Master.' present. Regression: admin login works, /admin reachable, /past-papers 200, /store 200, /search?q=quadratic returns 2 results.

issues: Pre-existing hydration warning (iter19/20): <span> cannot be a child of <option>. Editor-injected data-ve-dynamic wrapper spans around dynamic option label text in Home.js. Dev-only warning, not caused by this iteration.

critical_code_review_comments: ChaptersList.js line 11 still uses window.location.pathname to detect /learn prefix — recommend useLocation() from react-router for SSR/testing consistency (carry-over from iter19).
ChaptersList.js: If a subject briefly returns empty chapters (network flake), user sees fallback 'No chapters available yet' with no retry. Consider adding a Retry button.

The auto-redirect (navigate replace:true) means the intermediate /learn/igcse/{subject} URL never appears in history but is bookmarkable and will always re-redirect — good UX. However, if a user later wants a chapter-index view, they'll need a different route.

Home.js still has the <option>-<span> hydration warning around past-papers finder dropdowns (Home.js option labels wrapped with editor tracking spans). Suggest guarding editor-injected wrappers so they don't render inside <option>.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (all P1 redirects, workspace tabs, homepage sections, regression flows verified)

seed_data_creation: None (Combined Science + Co-ordinated Sciences pre-seeded via MongoDB by main agent)
context_for_next_testing_agent: All P1-P6 upgrades verified working. ChaptersList redirect pattern is solid. New regression test file test_iter21_p1_p2.py verifies (a) 6 IGCSE subjects present, (b) each subject has redirect-ready chapters, (c) new subjects have >=10 chapters. Reuse for future iterations. Only outstanding issue is the pre-existing dev-only <span>/<option> hydration warning around Home.js past-papers finder dropdowns.
